extDescription.message: Save bilibili videos you can already watch, in the best quality your own account allows. Merged in your browser; no servers, no tracking.

notVideoPage.message: Open a bilibili video page (www.bilibili.com/video/…) first.

signedOut.message: Not signed in: up to 480P. Sign in for 1080P.

signedInBasic.message: Signed in as $1. Up to 1080P; higher tiers need a bilibili membership.

signedInVip.message: Signed in as $1 with membership: every tier your account can play.

doneRaw.message: Saved the original video and audio files.

ffmpegHint.message: To keep Dolby Vision, merge the two files with ffmpeg:

dvNote.message: Saved as two original files to keep Dolby Vision

disclaimer.message: Spool only saves what your account can already play, for personal offline viewing. Respect creators' rights; do not re-upload. Not affiliated with bilibili.

errNeedLogin.message: This video needs you to sign in to bilibili.

errRisk.message: bilibili is rate-limiting requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.

errNoPermission.message: Your account cannot play this video (members-only, paid or region-locked).

errNoDash.message: This video has no separate streams Spool can save.

errNetwork.message: Network error. Check your connection and try again.

errTooLarge.message: This file is too large to build in memory in this browser. Use Chrome or Edge 116 or later.
